liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this and Masterpiece suit the set's slightly subdued tone; Reviewer liked it on first listen; on second listen still good, not great [11][16]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Played brightly and accurately, with some audible comments from a young woman nearby [11]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer finds the sudden shift from soft to heavy late in the song jarring and forced [16]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (1 review): An older man next to the reviewer went wild during this song, and the reviewer joined in [8]

## The recordings

- **gd88-02-16.aud.wiley.15477.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 124 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds muddled, but remains listenable, especially for those who like raw audience sound; Audience tape is muddled and statically dirty, though not unlistenable [10][11]
- **gd1988-02-16.aud.schoepsCMC3.miller.14954.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 125 min [2]
- **gd1988-02-16.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.88400.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 126 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer credits C Miller's recording with good sound quality; Sounds good played loud, though the band makes many lyric mistakes; Mix muddy; Weir's guitar hard to hear, and Brent sometimes overwhelms everyone else [14][15][16]
- **gd1988-02-16.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.103111.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 123 min; rated 2.29/5 by 7 [5]
- **gd1988-02-16.nak300.andrewf.96636.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 120 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood up front watching Jerry and Brent smile after drums; an older hippie beside them went wild [8]
- Mardi Gras Parade took place during Iko Iko with Batucaje, and Hamza El Din joined the drums [3]
- Mardi Gras Parade and Iko Iko featured the Batucaje drum group [6]
- Reviewer finds energy lacking, sounding like the start of a tour, despite a good setlist [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-02-16.aud.wiley.15477.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps CMC3/MK41>DAT>CDR [1]. Also: Schoeps CMC3/MK41 to DAT to CDR, via Charlie Miller, reseeded by T. Wiley as a fixed copy [1]
- **gd1988-02-16.aud.schoepsCMC3.miller.14954.shnf**: source: Schoeps CMC3/MK41>Dat>CD [2]. Also: Audience recording made with Schoeps CMC3 microphones, circulated by Miller [2]
- **gd1988-02-16.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.88400.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90) D [3]. Also: Schoeps CMC3/MK41 to DAT to CD; tapes supplied by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [3]
- **gd1988-02-16.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.103111.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90) [5]. Also: Reviewer doubts this is a true soundboard, saying it obviously is not one [17]
- **gd1988-02-16.nak300.andrewf.96636.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: OTS AUD: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > patched thru one Sony D5 > Sony WM-D6C > Maxell MX-90's with no Dolby. [6]. Also: Nak 300 source patched with sections from the 15477 recording in Space [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1988-02-17 Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-02-17-henry-j-kaiser-convention-center-oakland-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-02-16 Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-02-16-henry-j-kaiser-convention-center-oakland-ca-usa/) [22]
